title: Trading Made Simpler: Binance Convert is Now Accessible on Buy/Sell Page
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To provide a more seamless and simplified trading experience, eligible users can now access  Binance Convert  from the  Buy/Sell  section on Binance App. Previously, crypto-to-crypto trading was available through  Binance Convert  as a separate service. With this update, eligible users in supported countries can now trade  crypto-to-crypto  directly within  Buy/Sell,  alongside buying or selling crypto with local currencies, by selecting their desired asset in the  From/To  section.  This creates a more unified and easy-to-navigate experience for buying, selling, and converting supported crypto and fiat assets.  Users can now enjoy a more streamlined experience - no more navigating between separate sections to convert, buy or sell crypto; everything is now accessible in one place. Note : This update affects  user navigation only . No action is required from users. How to Access Buy/Sell on Binance App: Step 1 : Tap on the  [Trade]  tab.  Step 2:  Go to the  [Buy/Sell]  tab. Step 3:  Choose your desired  Crypto or Fiat asset  in the “ From/To”  section   to start trading. Please Note: Depending on the assets, currencies and the order type selected by the user, the UI will display the applicable Product Terms ( Covert Services Terms  or  Buy&Sell Crypto Services Terms , as applicable); There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Stay tuned for further updates as we continue to enhance our user experience. If you have any questions, please reach out to  Binance Customer Support Team  for assistance.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-17
